title: マザー

versions.note: the Japanese cartridge (MMC3, 256 KB program, 128 KB CHR; MOTHER-1.00 at the end of its program)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on fceumm (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge and snaps were studied outside it

The table: read off the naming screen, whose grid shows each kana under its tile in the nametables; digits from the party's status row; the opening's lines and a fight's pages held against their pictures
The message window: found in snaps of a page typing, by its frame of tiles in the nametables (read at 0x80002000); a fight's window, three rows and scrolling, from snaps of a fight
The cartridge's program isn't in fceumm's map, so the build check waited for the harness to give a Famicom cartridge whole at 0x01000000 (#215)
Played through the hero's first fight, a talk in the sister's room and a second fight: three stretches, each replayed from a state with the script loaded

What the script said agreed with the rows read off 32 of 32 pictures, over 3 scenes; 4 pages said inside a press have no picture. No screen without text was among them. Each snap's tiles, decoded apart from the script, gave the same rows
150 harness calls in all (by the record), the budget: most went on finding the way about the house
notes: Read by the script games/fc/FC-20CC079D.lua: the message window's rows, found by its frame in the nametables, once they have stood a third of a second; in a fight, each row as the window scrolls. Not read: who speaks (the game doesn't show it), the opening's lines (not in a window), menus and other windows, the naming screen. Names chosen in play come out as typed.
